description: This Java source file defines the class `IsolatedTestCase` which contains numerous unit test methods for testing various aspects of the SalesManager e-commerce platform. The tests include creating references, searching and retrieving products, creating categories, users, and manufacturers, as well as testing configuration modules and static content handling. The class is heavily integrated with Spring for dependency injection, utilizing multiple service classes to perform CRUD operations and various business logic tasks.

classes.name: IsolatedTestCase
classes.description: JUnit test class for isolated testing of various services and functionalities within the SalesManager platform. Contains multiple test methods for creating, retrieving, and managing products, categories, manufacturers, configurations, and static content. Uses Spring's dependency injection to acquire service instances.

methods.name: test1CreateReferences
methods.description: Initializes the database with test data using the `populate` method of `initializationDatabase`.

methods.name: testSearchProduct
methods.description: Searches for products in the default merchant store with specific criteria such as category IDs and availability status.

methods.name: testGetMerchant
methods.description: Retrieves and prints out the default merchant store.

methods.name: testCreateProductWithImage
methods.description: Creates a product with an associated image, including reading an image file, creating `ProductImage` and `ProductImageDescription`, and linking it to a product.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates and saves a new product with descriptions, images, categories, manufacturer, availability, and pricing details.

methods.name: test2CreateProducts
methods.description: Creates multiple categories, manufacturers, and products with various configurations and relationships among them.

methods.name: test3CreateUser
methods.description: Creates user groups and permissions within the platform, setting up basic user access roles.

methods.name: testGetProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a product by ID and outputs its descriptions count.

methods.name: testGetProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products for a specific category and locale, repeating the operation multiple times.

methods.name: testGetProductsByCategories
methods.description: Attempts to delete a category and outputs confirmation; commented code indicates possible product retrieval by IDs.

methods.name: testCategory
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical category structure with descriptions and relationships, demonstrating category creation with parent-child links.

methods.name: testGetModules
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs registered integration modules related to shipping.

methods.name: testCreateModules
methods.description: Creates and serializes configuration modules for integrations like Canada Post and USPS, testing JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: testCreateManufacturer
methods.description: Creates country, language, currency, store, and manufacturer entities, demonstrating complex setup and relationships.

methods.name: testStoreRandomProducts
methods.description: Generates and saves a large number of random products with various attributes for performance or testing purposes.
